gherkin.feature: KeystoneJS Post Form – ISP Input Validation
gherkin.scenario: Create a new post with various input values
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I click on Create Post button
I fill in the post title field
I fill in the post Content Brief field
I fill in the post Content Extended field
